title: Surreal Throne Over River
description: A surreal painting depicts a giant demonic figure with black horns, glowing pink eyes, and a golden crown floating on a dark cloud above a river. Below, a bearded man in a black shirt and a green-skinned figure appear in the foreground, while a soldier in green uniform sits at a wooden table on a dock beside two horses and a factory with smokestacks in the background.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene featuring a massive shadowy demon with large black horns and glowing pink eyes wearing an ornate golden crown, floating on a dark blue cloud pillow with lit candles and floating papers. Below is a serene river landscape with a wooden dock where a soldier in green uniform sits at a table with a vase of flowers. In the foreground, a bearded long-haired man and a green-skinned character are visible. Two horses stand near a fence with a factory and smokestacks in the distance under a dramatic sky.
